user.title: Set up PadSpan HA
user.description: Local-first setup (no API required). Everything else, including how often PadSpan updates, is set in the PadSpan panel in the sidebar.

abort.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check Home Assistant logs.

wled_on.name: WLED on with its look
wled_on.description: Turns WLED lights on with the look PadSpan remembered for them, exactly, with no flash. A light PadSpan doesn't run is turned on by Home Assistant as usual.

brightness_pct.name: Brightness
brightness_pct.description: Brightness in percent. Leave empty for the remembered brightness.

transition.name: Fade
transition.description: Fade time in seconds. Leave empty for the remembered fade.

wled_off.name: WLED off
wled_off.description: Turns WLED lights off the way PadSpan does, keeping their remembered look for the next time they come on.

transition.name: Fade
transition.description: Fade time in seconds. Leave empty for the remembered fade.

reload_screens.name: Reload screens
reload_screens.description: Loads the open PadSpan pages again, so new code reaches a screen nobody is standing at. Needs Open screens switched on in PadSpan's Settings.

screens.name: Screens
screens.description: Names or ids of the screens to reload. Leave empty for every screen.

announce.name: Announce on screens
announce.description: Shows a message big over the open PadSpan pages for a few seconds, with a chime, and reads it aloud if asked. Needs Open screens switched on in PadSpan's Settings.

title.name: Title
title.description: A short line above the message.

screens.name: Screens
screens.description: Names or ids of the screens to show it on. Leave empty for every screen.

speak.name: Speak
speak.description: Read the message aloud with the screen's own browser voice.

save_not_written.title: PadSpan could not confirm a save ({store})
save_not_written.description: PadSpan saved its data ({store}), but the file on disk does not hold what was saved, or could not be read back. The latest changes may only be in memory, and would be lost when Home Assistant restarts. Check that the disk Home Assistant runs on is not full or read-only, and look for the error in the Home Assistant log. This notice goes away by itself the next time a save is confirmed.
